card.title: Nintendo Switch No Backlight

claims.statement: Test a Switch backlight by dry-fitting a known-good LCD's backlight ribbon (screen gets slightly brighter if the circuit works).

Three backlight test points opposite the backlight connector should match reference diode readings within about 0.2; low/short = check components near the backlight IC; OL = broken trace or corroded pad under the IC (leftmost point OL can also be a bad diode).
Liquid commonly corrodes pads under the backlight IC; fix by jumpering the pad and reballing the IC.

procedure: Fix shorts, or jumper broken pads and reball/replace the backlight IC.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Bending a test LCD ribbon too far rips it.
card.caveats: Reference diode values are only in images. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
